name: Australia
year: 2024-25 (income year 1 July 2024 - 30 June 2025 = OECD 2025); 2025-26 also modelled
kernel_gaps: Out / countryMain hold whole units; the AU liability is in cents (tax 'for each $1' at 16 %, levy shade-in 10 %), so autax keeps its own contract writer (2 decimals)
multi-segment credit taper: LITO (5 % then 1.5 %) written as the larger of two Credits (proved equal to s. 61-115, lito_kernel_eq)
surcharge whose rate depends on income tiers and is charged on the whole base (MLS tiers 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 %); HELP 2024-25 whole-income bands
levy with a family-income reduction apportioned between spouses (MLA s. 8(2)-(4))
means-tested benefit with two methods and an income-support passport (FTB A Method 1/2, Sch 1 cl 38L)
PAYG withholding formula tables (Schedule 1 coefficients, +99 cents, half-up dollar rounding)

headline: The PAYG withholding schedule in force from July 2024 into 2026 still uses the 2023-24 Medicare levy thresholds and leaves the low income tax offset to the return (low earners over-withheld by up to $765 a year, never under), and the FTB A supplement's $80,000 limit, never indexed, is a $916-per-child notch that catches more families every year; the OECD's 2025 lines are reproduced 40/40 once its two assumptions (energy supplement, Parenting Payment passport) are stated.
